actions.desc: The elk bugles its might at its opponents, bolstering its confidence. It has advantage on the next attack roll it makes before the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Bolstering Bugle

actions.desc: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 9 (2d4+4) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 STR save or be pushed up to 15 feet away from the elk.
actions.desc_ru: Действие «Кик»; тип: action. Производный машинный текст из структурированных полей записи; полный исходный текст — в поле desc (требуется перевод и редакторская вычитка).
actions.name: Kick

actions.desc: The elk makes one Ram attack and one Kick attack.

actions.desc: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 11 (2d6+4) bludgeoning damage.
actions.desc_ru: Атака оружием ближнего боя: +6 к попаданию, досягаемость 10 фт., одна цель. Попадание: 11 (2к6+4) дробящего урона.
actions.name: Ram

traits.desc: If the elk moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a Ram attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 STR save or be knocked prone.
